description: Address review feedback: (1) Remove raw config error messages from unauthenticated /health endpoint, exposing only a count. (2) Add health endpoint integration test verifying degraded status and absence of raw error messages.
steps: In apps/backend/app/api/v1/health.py, change 'config_errors': settings.startup_errors to 'config_error_count': len(settings.startup_errors) to avoid exposing internal security config details to unauthenticated callers.

Add a health endpoint integration test in apps/backend/tests/test_config_resilience.py that monkeypatches settings.startup_errors and verifies the /health endpoint returns degraded status with config_error_count and does NOT expose raw error messages.
acceptance_criteria: The /health endpoint returns config_error_count (integer) instead of config_errors (list of strings) when degraded
A test verifies the health endpoint degraded response structure
The test confirms raw error messages are not exposed in the response
findings: All 229 tests pass. Changed config_errors to config_error_count in health endpoint. Added 2 integration tests (degraded with errors, healthy without errors). Both tests confirm raw error messages are not exposed in the response.
